entries.title: Isaiah 38:1
segments: ¶In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, went to him and said to him, "Thus says the LORD: 'Set your house in order, for you shall die and not live.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 38:2
segments: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the LORD,

entries.title: Isaiah 38:3
segments: and said, "Remember now, O LORD, I pray, how I have walked before You in truth and with a loyal heart, and have done [what is] good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:4
segments: And the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,

entries.title: Isaiah 38:5
segments: "Go and tell Hezekiah, 'Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; surely I will add to your days fifteen years.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:6
segments: "I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city."'

entries.title: Isaiah 38:7
segments: "And this [is] the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing which He has spoken:

entries.title: Isaiah 38:8
segments: "Behold, I will bring the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down with the sun on the sundial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward." So the sun returned ten degrees on the dial by which it had gone down.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:9
segments: ¶This is the writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:

entries.title: Isaiah 38:10
segments: I said, "In the prime of my life I shall go to the gates of Sheol; I am deprived of the remainder of my years."

entries.title: Isaiah 38:11
segments: I said, "I shall not see YAH, The LORD in the land of the living; I shall observe man no more among the inhabitants of the world.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:12
segments: My life span is gone, Taken from me like a shepherd's tent; I have cut off my life like a weaver. He cuts me off from the loom; From day until night You make an end of me.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:13
segments: I have considered until morning-Like a lion, So He breaks all my bones; From day until night You make an end of me.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:14
segments: Like a crane [or] a swallow, so I chattered; I mourned like a dove; My eyes fail [from looking] upward. O LORD, I am oppressed; Undertake for me!

entries.title: Isaiah 38:15
segments: "What shall I say? He has both spoken to me, And He Himself has done [it]. I shall walk carefully all my years In the bitterness of my soul.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:16
segments: O Lord, by these [things men] live; And in all these [things is] the life of my spirit; So You will restore me and make me live.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:17
segments: Indeed [it was] for [my own] peace [That] I had great bitterness; But You have lovingly [delivered] my soul from the pit of corruption, For You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:18
segments: For Sheol cannot thank You, Death cannot praise You; Those who go down to the pit cannot hope for Your truth.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:19
segments: The living, the living man, he shall praise You, As I [do] this day; The father shall make known Your truth to the children.

entries.title: Isaiah 38:20
segments: "The LORD [was ready] to save me; Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments All the days of our life, in the house of the LORD."

entries.title: Isaiah 38:21
segments: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a lump of figs, and apply [it] as a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover."

entries.title: Isaiah 38:22
segments: And Hezekiah had said, "What [is] the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?"
